universe_definition: Liquid PSX equities with active OHLCV quotes and quarterly published fundamentals.
heuristic_quarantine: Provisional exclusion bounds (+/- 5 sessions around announcement and jumps >= 35%).

portfolio_allocation.cash_constraint: Morning buys bounded strictly by prior session close cash (C_{s-1}). Zero leverage.
portfolio_allocation.candidate_ordering: Fundamental score descending. Alphabetical sorting strictly prohibited.

execution_timing.signal_generation: Session t close (using data up to t close).
execution_timing.order_entry: Session t+1 open (executable open price > 0, volume > 0).
execution_timing.order_exit: Session t+10 close (executable close price > 0, volume > 0).
execution_timing.delayed_exit_policy: Hold position if quote missing or halted at close until executable quote appears; never liquidate at entry price.

missing_volume_policy.enabled_mode: Lagged volume V_{s-1} <= 0 caps spend at 0.0 (rejects order).
